answer: Sybil resistance arises when each challenge commits to a task instance whose salt is derived from a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse. Until the drand quicknet round is finalized, an attacker cannot know the salt, so timber, willow, and karst worker identities cannot precompute valid solutions or farm them offline. A commit-reveal phase fixes responses before reveal, while beacon unbiasability prevents selective withholding; duplicating identities therefore multiplies cost without creating reusable work.
